body: Founder: 'ensure stats is working' + 'add a 20th bot.' Root cause of empty leaderboard: neither matchmaker systemd unit set IDUNA_AGENT_NAME/SECRET, so every match silently had WOTAN reporting disabled despite the REDGARDEN-BOTS agent already being fully provisioned in IDUNA since 2026-07-24. Fixed via gitignored var/redgarden-iduna-agent.env + EnvironmentFile=. Also: matchmaker only spawns a match at exactly lobby_size (20), so 19 bots + no human meant zero matches ever completed on their own -- bumped bot-pool to 20, deliberately trading away human queueing on :7778 for a self-sustaining data-generating pool. Verified live: new server prints 'IDUNA agent configured', new match spawned immediately.
title: Fixed hero-stats reporting (missing IDUNA creds) + bot pool now self-sustaining (20 bots)
